name: get_tables_information
description: Get database schema metadata including table structures, columns, data types, and relationships for the PostgreSQL database. Call this tool first to understand what data is available before writing SQL queries.

name: execute_sql_query
description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the PostgreSQL database. Call get_tables_information first to understand the available schema.

sql_query.description: The SQL query to execute. Must be read-only (SELECT only). Use the schema from get_tables_information to write correct queries.

description.description: A clear description of what this query analyzes or retrieves.
